title.narrative: As a trusted partner in the country, UNICEF contributed to accelerating solutions to expand access to education through the implementation of the Education Supply and Demand Plan with SEDUC, the Champions for Education initiative, pedagogical innovation, and humanitarian action. Through these initiatives, 147,737 children were directly reached together with partners 1,131 teachers were supported, and 720 schools were improved. USD 2.4 million in local resources was mobilized, and enrollment increased 3.6 times faster in municipalities participating in the Champions for Education initiative, consolidating shared responsibility for inclusive education.
